stem:
Bela compares two snack packets. One lists more protein and fibre and less sugar. The labels also show total carbohydrate.

Which better fits a health-minded choice from the labels?

options.text: The packet whose fibre equals its total carbohydrate on the label.
The packet with more protein and fibre and less sugar.
The sweeter packet, because taste is the only nutrient.
Neither packet; labels given for the same amount cannot be compared.

teacher.key_rationale: Compare protein, fibre, and sugar on the labels. More protein and fibre with less sugar fits better.
